C01-ENCLOSURE-COARSE: PASS -- closed form inside brute-force partial sum + crude tail box in 240 of 240 random periodic cases
C02-ENCLOSURE-FINE: PASS -- closed form inside the window-based tail box (tighter than C01) in 240 of 240 cases
C03-PERIOD-INVARIANCE: PASS -- invariance under period doubling/tripling and linearity in 240 of 240 cases
C04-CALIB-NORMS: PASS -- ||1||_B^2 = 2, ||a_j||_B^2 = 3/(2*4^j) and layer orthogonality for j <= 8, single dyadic residue 2/4^J (54 equalities)
C05-CALIB-GRAM-ENTRIES: PASS -- G_22 = 3/2, G_23 = 13/10, G_33 = 14/5, b_2 = 3/2, b_3 = 2 (NOTE-SOURCE-CZ sec. 7)
C06-SPLIT-IDENTITY: PASS -- ||x||^2 = x(1)^2 + ||Lx||^2/2 + ||Hx||^2/8 (polarised) on all three Gram tables, target vectors and 60 random sequences (2832 of 2832)
C07-GRAM-POSITIVE-DEFINITE: PASS -- all 71 LDL pivots positive (Gram matrix of r_2..r_72 positive definite), symmetry
C08-CALIB-DK-RECORD: PASS -- d_K(1)^2 for K = 2..12 equal the review's exact values (52/251, 95/766, ..., K = 12)
C09-DK-TWO-METHODS: PASS -- c_2 = 160/251, c_3 = 105/251 for target 1; LDL distances equal direct normal-equation solves for all four targets, K <= 16 (61 of 61)
C10-NORMAL-EQUATIONS-POINTWISE: PASS -- K = 8 minimiser for A_2: residual orthogonal to r_2..r_8 over period 840 and ||residual||^2 = d_8(A_2)^2
C11-DK-POSITIVE-MONOTONE: PASS -- 0 < d_K(x)^2 <= d_{K-1}(x)^2 <= ||x||^2 for x in {1, A_2, A_4, A_8} and 2 <= K <= 72
C12-DELTA-CONVENTION: PASS -- backward Delta: t_Q(1) = 0, p_h(1) = 0 and p_h = A_Q on 1 <= n < K_h for all cuts K_h <= KMAX; forward Delta: t_2(1) = 1, p_h(n) = A_Q(n+1) on 1 <= n < K_0 for every Q in (2, 4, 8), S^fwd_{2,1}(1) = -1 and ||A_2 - p^fwd_0||^2 - ||Y^fwd||^2/2 - ||D^fwd||^2/8 = 1 (identity (1) fails by exactly S(1)^2 = 1, period 840), |gamma^fwd_{2,K}| >= 5/16 at K in [2, 3]
C13-IDENTITY-12: PASS -- gamma_{Q,K} = sum_{u<K} s_Q(u)/(u(u+1)) for Q in {2,4,8}, 2 <= K <= 73 (pure summation by parts, convention-free)
C14-BOUND-3-FINITE: PASS -- |gamma_{Q,K}| < 5/(4Q^2) for Q in {2,4,8} and all 2 <= K <= 4096; max |gamma| = Q=2: 1/6 (bound 5/16, attained at K in [3, 4]), Q=4: 1/20 (bound 5/64, attained at K in [5, 6, 7, 8]), Q=8: 1/72 (bound 5/256, attained at K in [9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16]); DIAGNOSTIC floats: 1.667e-01 vs 3.125e-01, 5.000e-02 vs 7.812e-02, 1.389e-02 vs 1.953e-02
C15-IDENTITY-13: PASS -- e_K(n) = sum_{l<=n/K} s_Q(floor(n/l)) + K floor(n/K) gamma_{Q,K} pointwise, all cuts K_h <= 72, n <= 2000 (18000 points)
C16-IDENTITY-14: PASS -- e_K(n) = sum_{u=K}^n T_Q(u) [r_{u+1}(n) - r_u(n)] pointwise, all cuts K_h <= 72, n <= 400 (3600 points)
C17-IDENTITY-1: PASS -- ||A_Q - avg_J||^2 = ||Y||^2/(2J^2) + ||D||^2/(8J^2) exactly for (Q,J) in [(2, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4), (4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 3), (8, 1), (8, 2)], the three norms from the three independent tables
C18-DIRECT-PERIODIC-CROSSCHECK: PASS -- ||S||^2, ||D||^2, ||Y||^2 and S(1) = 0 by direct evaluation over the full period (840 and 720720) agree with the bilinear table expansion for (Q,J)=(2,1), (Q,J)=(4,1), (Q,J)=(2,2)
C19-LEMMA-SPAN-INEQUALITY: PASS -- k = 1 coefficient -t_Q(1) of p_h is 0 and p_h has no r_k with k > K_h, so p_h in span{r_2..r_{K_h}}; ||A_Q - avg_J||^2 >= d_{K_{J-1}}(A_Q)^2 and ||Y||^2 >= 2 J^2 d_{K_{J-1}}(A_Q)^2 - ||D||^2/4 exactly on all computed (Q,J)
C20-EFFICIENCY-RATIOS: PASS -- every efficiency ratio ||A_Q - p_h||^2 / d_{K_h}(A_Q)^2 and ||A_Q - avg_J||^2 / d_{K_{J-1}}(A_Q)^2 is >= 1 (corollary of Lemma D, i.e. of C19; recorded as a consistency line, not an independent test)
